items.problem: UWP `ApplicationView.IsScreenCaptureEnabled` (screen-capture / content protection) has no skill mapping; the windowing/GetForCurrentView guidance implies AppWindow carries it, so the agent guessed `AppWindow.IsScreenCaptureEnabled` and hit CS1061 before rewriting to Win32 SetWindowDisplayAffinity.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~2243 (CS1061), ~2302 (fix), ~2950 (agent summary). skill grep for ScreenCapture/DisplayAffinity/WDA_ = 0 hits.
items.root_cause: No documented UWP→WinUI 3 mapping for screen-capture protection; AppWindow lacks the member and the Win32 substitute was undocumented.
items.change: Added `IsScreenCaptureEnabled` adaptable pattern in unsupported-api-inventory.json routed to a new `screen-capture` anchor (placed before the generic GetForCurrentView/ApplicationView patterns so the injected TODO points to the correct section); added a `` section to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md documenting SetWindowDisplayAffinity + WDA constants + HWND retrieval; added a clarifying note under the GetForCurrentView table that per-view capabilities like IsScreenCaptureEnabled are not AppWindow members.
items.expected_effect: On a re-run, the IsScreenCaptureEnabled line gets a `PATTERNS.md#screen-capture` TODO and the agent writes SetWindowDisplayAffinity directly, with no CS1061 build round-trip.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run migration of any app using IsScreenCaptureEnabled: no CS1061 on AppWindow.IsScreenCaptureEnabled, and the injected TODO reads `see PATTERNS.md#screen-capture`.

items.problem: A `DataTemplate x:DataType="local:Scenario"` with `{x:Bind}` failed markup compile (WMC0909/WMC1111); the x:Bind skill section covered only XLS0414/MC3074 namespace issues, not the project-local DataTemplate resolution failure or its `{Binding}` fallback.
items.root_cause: Existing x:Bind guidance under-emphasized the DataTemplate x:DataType project-local-type resolution case.
items.change: Extended the existing `### x:Bind and compiled bindings` paragraph to name WMC0909/WMC1111 (and the WMC1509 co-symptom) and prescribe the classic `{Binding}` fallback. Kept as a sharpening of existing content, not a new section, because the fix is one recovery sentence and a script route would over-fire on valid x:Bind usage.
items.expected_effect: Agent recognizes WMC0909/WMC1111 in DataTemplates and falls back to {Binding} without exploratory retries.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run any UWP sample-shell migration with a ListBox/ListView x:Bind item template: WMC0909/WMC1111 is resolved on the first fix attempt (or avoided).
